findings.claim: Function _row_for_result interleaves multiple unrelated concerns: loads ground truth, computes boundary metrics, alignment metrics, contact metrics, builds output dict, and constructs split log.
findings.quote:
def _row_for_result(fixture: Fixture, spec: CandidateSpec, result: Any, master: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    gt = load_gt_rallies(master, fixture.video_id)
    spans = result.spans
    boundary = score_boundaries(spans, gt)
    classifications = classify_all(spans, gt)
    merged = merged_span_indices(spans, gt)
findings.suggested_fix: Consider splitting boundary scoring, alignment computation, contact scoring, and split log generation into separate focused functions, or at least group related computations together.
